title: Refrigerated Warehouse & Distribution Manager
description:
TITLE: Refrigerated Warehouse & Distribution Manager
TYPE: Direct Hire
LOCATION: Philadelphia, PA
ONSITE/REMOTE/HYBRID: Onsite
START DATE: June 2026
SHIFT: 2:00 AM - 10:00 AM; Flexibility to work varying shifts, weekends, and extended hours as operational needs require is essential.


We are seeking an experienced Refrigerated Warehouse & Distribution Manager to oversee refrigerated and frozen warehouse operations, outbound distribution, fleet coordination, and order fulfillment activities within a fast-paced food distribution environment. This role is responsible for leading warehouse, inventory, routing, dispatch, and transportation functions while ensuring operational efficiency, food safety compliance, and high levels of customer service.

This is a fully onsite position supporting a 24-hour distribution operation. Flexibility to work varying shifts, weekends, and extended hours as operational needs require is essential.

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Manage distribution and fleet activities including routing, scheduling, dispatch, delivery performance, and coordination with outside transportation providers.
  • Maintain inventory accuracy through proper lot control, product rotation, shrink reduction practices, and warehouse organization.
  • Oversee refrigerated and frozen warehouse operations including receiving, storage, inventory management, order picking, staging, shipping, and product rotation.
  • Support food safety, sanitation, temperature control, and regulatory compliance requirements related to refrigerated and frozen food products.
  • Maintain a visible presence within warehouse and distribution operations to support employee engagement and operational execution.
  • Lead, coach, schedule, and hold accountable warehouse employees, drivers, dispatch personnel, and support staff across multiple shifts.
  • Identify operational bottlenecks and implement practical improvements to strengthen productivity, communication, fulfillment flow, and shipping accuracy.
  • Partner closely with sales, customer service, purchasing, production, quality assurance, and operations teams to support accurate and timely order fulfillment.
  • Support strong customer service standards by ensuring reliable deliveries, accurate shipments, and timely issue resolution.
  • Reinforce safe work practices, proper equipment usage, housekeeping standards, and transportation compliance requirements where applicable.

QUALIFICATIONS
  • 5+ years of management experience within refrigerated/frozen warehousing, food distribution, cold-chain logistics, meat/poultry distribution, or related operational environments
  • Experience within meat, poultry, protein, or foodservice distribution operations is highly preferred
  • Experience managing warehouse operations including receiving, inventory control, order fulfillment, shipping, dispatch, routing, and delivery performance
  • Hands-on leadership style with strong communication, problem-solving, and organizational skills
  • Experience supervising warehouse personnel, drivers, dispatchers, or shift leadership teams in fast-paced operational settings
  • Knowledge of food safety practices, sanitation standards, temperature control, and handling procedures for perishable products
  • Strong understanding of inventory systems, warehouse management systems, routing functions, and Microsoft Office or similar business software
  • Ability to manage competing priorities and operate effectively under time-sensitive delivery schedules
  • Ability to work onsite within a multi-shift, 24-hour operational environment

EOE STATEMENT

We do not discriminate or allow discrimination on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related medical conditions), age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, genetic information, registered domestic partner status, marital status, disability, status as a crime victim, protected veteran status, political affiliation, union membership, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Warehouse/Shipping Supervisor
description:
TITLE: Warehouse/Shipping Supervisor
TYPE: Direct Hire
LOCATION: Philadelphia, PA
ONSITE/REMOTE/HYBRID: Onsite
START DATE: June 2026
SHIFT: 2:00 AM - 10:00 AM; Flexibility to work varying shifts, weekends, and extended hours as operational needs require is essential.


We are seeking a hands-on Warehouse / Shipping Supervisor to oversee daily warehouse and shipping operations within a refrigerated and frozen food distribution environment. This role is responsible for supervising warehouse activities including order picking, staging, loading, shipping, inventory control, dock coordination, and product movement while ensuring operational efficiency, safety, and order accuracy.

This is a fully onsite position supporting a multi-shift, 24-hour warehouse and distribution operation. Flexibility to work varying shifts, weekends, and extended hours as operational needs require is essential.

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Reinforce proper handling, storage, temperature control, and rotation procedures for refrigerated and frozen food products.
  • Ensure customer orders are picked, verified, staged, loaded, and shipped accurately and within required timelines.
  • Support inventory accuracy through proper product rotation, cycle counts, lot tracking, location management, and discrepancy reporting.
  • Maintain and review shipping and warehouse documentation including bills of lading, manifests, pick tickets, packing lists, and receiving records.
  • Supervise daily warehouse and shipping activities including order picking, staging, loading, shipping, receiving support, dock organization, and product movement.
  • Lead, coach, train, and schedule warehouse personnel including selectors, forklift operators, loaders, and other shift employees.
  • Coordinate with drivers, dispatch, customer service, purchasing, quality assurance, production, sales, and other departments to support operational flow and resolve issues.
  • Enforce warehouse safety procedures, equipment usage standards, housekeeping expectations, and compliance with company policies.
  • Monitor warehouse equipment and facility conditions including forklifts, pallet jacks, dock equipment, and warehouse machinery, escalating maintenance concerns as needed.
  • Maintain a visible presence on the warehouse floor to support operational execution and employee performance.
  • Identify opportunities to improve productivity, reduce errors, streamline fulfillment processes, and strengthen operational accountability.

QUALIFICATIONS
  • High school diploma or GED required; Additional education or training related to logistics, warehousing, supply chain, food distribution, or management is preferred
  • Experience supervising hourly warehouse employees in fast-paced operational environments
  • Strong understanding of warehouse operations including order picking, staging, loading, receiving, shipping documentation, dock operations, and inventory control
  • Previous supervisory, lead, or management experience within warehouse, shipping, distribution, cold-storage, food, meat, poultry, or perishable goods environments
  • Forklift operation experience required; Forklift certification or ability to complete certification/training successfully is preferred
  • Ability to work in refrigerated and frozen warehouse environments
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage time-sensitive shipping schedules
  • Experience with warehouse systems, inventory tracking, data entry, and Microsoft Office or similar business software
  • Ability to stand and walk for extended periods and lift up to 50 lbs. as needed
  • Strong communication and coordination skills across multiple departments and operational teams
  • Understanding of warehouse safety practices, housekeeping standards, and equipment operation procedures

EOE STATEMENT
We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate or allow discrimination on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related medical conditions), age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, genetic information, registered domestic partner status, marital status, disability, status as a crime victim, protected veteran status, political affiliation, union membership, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Rotating Shift - Systems Support Analyst
description:
TITLE:  Systems Support Analyst – Rotating Shift
TYPE:  Contract
LOCATION:  Audubon, PA
ONSITE/REMOTE/HYBRID: Onsite  
START DATE:  June 2026
SHIFT:  Rotating shift, either 7:00 am – 7:00 pm or 7:00 pm – 7:00 am alternating (includes weekdays and weekends)


We are seeking an IT Operations Center Analyst to support a 24x7 IT Operations & Support Center environment responsible for monitoring and maintaining the stability of critical production technology systems. This role works within a rotating shift structure covering both daytime and overnight operations, including weekdays and weekends.

The Analyst will monitor enterprise technology environments, respond to operational incidents, troubleshoot technical issues, and coordinate escalation activities with subject matter experts when necessary. This position requires broad technical knowledge across multiple infrastructure and software platforms, strong problem-solving skills, and the ability to respond quickly to production issues to minimize business impact.


MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Monitor enterprise production systems and technology environments to ensure operational stability and availability.
  • Identify, troubleshoot, and respond to operational technology issues in real time.
  • Utilize monitoring and alerting tools to detect incidents and initiate remediation activities.
  • Escalate issues to subject matter experts and support teams when additional expertise is required.
  • Coordinate restoration activities to minimize downtime and operational impact.
  • Maintain awareness of overnight operational events and communicate status updates during shift transitions.
  • Collaborate with IT support teams, infrastructure personnel, business stakeholders, and external partners to resolve incidents efficiently.
  • Analyze system alerts, operational signals, and performance indicators to proactively identify risks or potential disruptions.
  • Assist with operational support activities across a broad range of hardware, software, and infrastructure technologies.
  • Participate in troubleshooting and diagnostic efforts to restore production functionality as quickly as possible.
  • Support continuous operational awareness and maintain familiarity with evolving systems, tools, and procedures.
  • Contribute to maintaining stable, secure, and reliable production technology operations within a 24x7 environment.
 
QUALIFICATIONS
  • Broad technical knowledge across multiple hardware, software, and infrastructure technology disciplines
  • Strong troubleshooting, diagnostic, and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to interpret monitoring system alerts and operational data to identify and respond to production issues
  • Experience working in operational support, systems monitoring, or IT infrastructure environments
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively across technical and business teams
  • Ability to prioritize and respond quickly in high-pressure operational situations
  • Ability to work rotating shifts, including overnight, weekend, and holiday coverage as required
  • Ability to work onsite in a 24x7 operational support environment
 
EOE STATEMENT

title: Senior Turbine Hardware Engineer
description:
TITLE: Senior Turbine Hardware Engineer
TYPE: Direct Hire
LOCATION: Lunenburg, MA
ONSITE/REMOTE/HYBRID: Hybrid
START DATE: April/May 2026
SHIFT: Day


We are seeking a Senior Turbine Hardware Engineer to lead the design, analysis, and qualification of key components and assemblies in high-performance steam turbines. This role focuses on developing optimized subcomponents—such as buckets, diaphragms, and nozzles—and ensuring their performance within the complete turbine system. Success requires both the use of advanced computational turbomachinery design tools and a solid grasp of fundamental analytical models.

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Lead the execution of technical scopes for steam and gas turbines, as well as generator assemblies, meeting project quality, schedule, and cost targets
  • Develop turbine system concepts that meet performance goals while streamlining detailed design phases
  • Conduct and review a wide range of engineering analyses—including thermodynamic modeling, blade shaping, flow path optimization, stress and rotordynamic evaluations, and CFD simulations—using industry-standard tools
  • Prepare project estimates and plans based on technical scope, customer needs, and identified risks
  • Organize and lead technical teams through the full product development life cycle
  • Mentor junior engineers in design methodologies, tools, and industry best practices
  • Represent the company in customer engagements, including with the U.S. Navy, with confidence and technical authority
  • Deliver clear, concise communication of technical and programmatic information to both technical and executive audiences
  • Monitor project milestones, manage risks, and provide accurate cost and schedule forecasts
  • Collaborate across internal departments, locations, and supply chain partners to address technical and manufacturing challenges
  • Apply principles of manufacturability, safety, and field-readiness to all hardware designs

QUALIFICATIONS
  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a closely related technical field
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience designing steam turbine or turbomachinery rotating components
  • Ability to obtain a security clearance
  • Familiarity with welded structures and large rotating hardware common in power generation applications
  • Demonstrated ability to drive product development from concept through validation and deployment
  • Experience applying systems engineering methods and integrating multidisciplinary design inputs
  • Strong foundation in mechanical engineering principles including material selection, structural analysis, thermodynamics, fluid mechanics, rotordynamics, and fatigue life prediction (LCF/HCF, creep)
Preferred Qualifications
  • Active security clearance
  • Experience with steam turbines supporting electric machinery, motor/drive systems, or electromechanical assemblies
  • Proficient in CAD software (Siemens NX or SolidWorks preferred)
  • Experience using turbine-specific design software (Concepts NREC, SoftInWay, or equivalent)
  • Skilled in finite element and multiphysics simulation tools (ANSYS preferred)
  • Understanding of fabrication, machining, and assembly processes for power generation equipment
  • Competence in project management software (MS Project, Jira)
  • Experience working on military contracts or defense-sector turbine systems
  • Knowledge of applicable military and industrial standards
  • Familiarity with design optimization techniques in turbomachinery applications

EOE STATEMENT

We do not discriminate or allow discrimination on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related medical conditions), age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, genetic information, registered domestic partner status, marital status, disability, status as a crime victim, protected veteran status, political affiliation, union membership, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Associate Director - Quality Systems, Regulatory & Compliance
description:
TITLE: Associate Director – Quality Systems, Regulatory & Compliance
TYPE: Direct Hire
LOCATION: East Windsor, NJ
ONSITE/REMOTE/HYBRID: Onsite with regular travel to Asbury Park, NJ
START DATE: May 2026


We are seeking an Associate Director, Quality Systems, Regulatory & Compliance to lead the execution and ongoing enhancement of quality systems, food safety programs, and regulatory compliance across designated manufacturing sites. This role is responsible for ensuring that products consistently meet internal standards, regulatory requirements, and customer expectations while promoting a culture of accountability, consistency, and audit readiness.

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Develop and implement risk-based audit schedules aligned with regulatory and certification requirements.
  • Maintain and enhance SOPs, work instructions, and quality system documentation.
  • Support the implementation and ongoing compliance with GMP, HACCP, FSMA, and other regulatory standards.
  • Manage the internal audit program, including planning, execution, reporting, and verification of corrective actions.
  • Drive audit readiness and ensure timely resolution of audit findings.
  • Support external, customer, and regulatory audits and inspections.
  • Lead the execution and continuous improvement of food safety, quality systems, programs, and compliance processes across assigned locations.
  • Lead investigations related to nonconformances, customer complaints, and audit observations.
  • Conduct root cause analysis and oversee CAPA implementation, tracking, and effectiveness.
  • Analyze trends and collaborate cross-functionally to implement practical, risk-based improvements.
  • Ensure all documentation, inspections, and testing records are accurate, complete, and audit-ready.
  • Communicate quality performance, compliance status, and audit readiness to site and senior leadership.
  • Support product hold, release, traceability, and recall readiness activities.
  • Assist with supplier qualification and monitoring in partnership with Procurement and Technical teams.
  • Review internal and external testing results as needed.
  • Oversee complaint management processes, including investigation, trending, and corrective actions.
  • Lead, coach, and develop quality team members across assigned sites.
  • Partner with Operations and other functional teams to ensure effective execution of quality and compliance initiatives.

QUALIFICATIONS
  • Bachelor's degree in Food Science, Microbiology, Chemistry, Biology, or a related scientific discipline
  • 3–5+ years of leadership experience managing quality or food safety teams
  • 7–10+ years of experience in quality, food safety, regulatory, or compliance roles within a regulated manufacturing environment
  • Strong knowledge of HACCP, FSMA, FDA regulations, and GMP-based systems
  • HACCP certification (or ability to obtain within a specified timeframe)
  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and drive execution in a manufacturing environment
  • Experience with internal audits, external audits, regulatory inspections, CAPA systems, and root cause analysis

title: Shipping Operations Support Coordinator
description:
TITLE: Shipping Operations Support Coordinator
TYPE: Direct Hire
LOCATION: Rutherford, NJ
ONSITE/REMOTE/HYBRID: Onsite
START DATE: April/May 2026

We are seeking a highly organized Shipping Operations Support Coordinator to play a key role in supporting day-to-day shipping activities and resolving logistics-related issues. This position acts as a central point of coordination between Customer Service, Accounts Receivable, and Shipping to ensure accurate billing, timely shipment tracking, and smooth operational flow. The ideal candidate is proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Manage incoming shipment tracking inquiries from internal teams and customers
  • Review shipping-related chargebacks using internal systems to identify discrepancies such as address corrections, billing errors, or refused deliveries
  • Investigate and resolve discrepancies to ensure accurate billing and compliance
  • Assist in preparing shipping rate quotes for parcel, LTL, and international shipments
  • Support both internal teams and customers with cost-related shipping inquiries
  • Provide timely updates on shipment status and determine appropriate next steps, including replacement shipments when needed
  • Track claims and maintain documentation related to shipping discrepancies
  • Assist with processing credits and reconciling shipping-related financial issues
  • Assist in preparing bills of lading (BOLs) and shipment documentation to ensure on-time pickups
  • Coordinate required paperwork and details for domestic and international shipments, including parcel and freight
  • Support return processes, including generating return labels and arranging necessary packaging solutions
  • Partner with Accounts Receivable to resolve return-related discrepancies
  • Submit and manage billing disputes with carriers, including follow-up to ensure timely resolution and credits
  • Support department managers with ad hoc tasks and business needs
  • Provide general administrative support across departments as needed
  • Assist with special projects, internal coordination, and operational initiatives

QUALIFICATIONS
  • Prior experience in shipping, logistics, or operations support preferred
  • Familiarity with parcel carriers (e.g., UPS) and freight shipping processes, including international shipments
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to work across multiple teams and interact with customers
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to review and validate billing or chargeback data
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications; experience with ERP systems (such as SAP Business One) and PSI software is a plus
  • Bilingual skills are a plus
